findings.evidence: `TypeB/Two.lean:55-65` says “no identification of the carrier below with that pinned group is available; so neither that endomorphism, nor the group of its fixed points, nor the quotient ... is stated”; `CFSGStatement/README.md:261-301` requires the explicit pinned Chevalley–Demazure carrier and rejects a classical matrix carrier as a fallback.
findings.fix: First construct or identify the canonical pinned simply connected `B₂` carrier and transport the special isogeny to it in its own prerequisite work; then define these three declarations on that carrier.
findings.issue: `halfFrobenius`, `steinberg` (line 135), and `Group` (line 303) are defined on `RankTwoBLieIndex.AmbientGroup`, although `TypeB/Two.lean` explicitly says this carrier is not identified with the pinned simply connected group and therefore no Steinberg map or fixed-point candidate may be stated on it. Root-subgroup equations identify an endomorphism only after the missing pinned-carrier identification; they do not establish that this is the roadmap's ambient object.

summary: The Suzuki constructions are attached to a provisional symplectic carrier that the existing API explicitly says is not identified with the required pinned simply connected group, so the claimed L2/L3 object lacks its prerequisite.
